summary_bullets: Report active ship-pr state for future phase names
Prevent progress reports from falling back to stale implement step marks during ship-pr phases
commit_message:
Render ship-pr progress for unlisted phases

Use ship-pr-state.sh presence, not a phase allow-list, to select the ship-pr progress renderer. Add a regression test covering an unlisted bump phase so future ship-pr phase names still render active ship-pr status.
